profile.headline: Retired - Senior Principal Embedded Software Engineer in Medical Devices
profile.jobTitle: Retired - Senior Principal Embedded Software Engineer in Medical Devices
profile.summary:
Broad background in a wide variety of embedded firmware and large-scale software design including medical devices, defense systems, avionics, and flight/sensor simulation.  Proven success in exercising extensive leadership skills and influencing the introduction of technology & process improvements. 

Experienced in technical supervision of team-oriented software development in FDA/DOD/FAA regulated, safety-critical environments as well as melding product and process initiatives such as IEC 62304 & 60601, “Agile” methodologies, RTCA DO-178, and SEI CMM/CMMI.  

Technical specialist in the systems definition and software design of safety critical computing with a strong focus towards multiprocessor real-time systems using a variety of programming languages and operating environments.

positions.title: Retired - Senior Principal Embedded Software Engineer in Medical Devices
positions.description: Retired but would consider short-term contract roles (remote) on a case by case basis

positions.title: Senior Principal Embedded Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Stryker Emergency Care (Physio Control), Redmond, WA
positions.description: Drive architectural design decisions across the entire spectrum of Physio products. As this is my second decade of experience at Physio, particular emphasis is on mentoring newly-hired engineering staff in the performance, safety, and design trade-offs of new and existing products.

positions.title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Continuing systems and software engineering activities across the entire spectrum of Physio products.  As this is my second decade of experience at Physio, particular emphasis is on mentoring newly-hired engineering staff in the performance, safety, and design trade-offs of existing products.

positions.title: Systems Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
Performing various systems engineering activities utilizing my prior experience in medical products and embedded software design.

✓ Analyze designs and assess compliance with IEC 60601 (3rd Edition).  Where necessary, generate, collect, and summarize objective evidence showing compliance with primary and collateral standards.  Provide detailed DFMECA analysis regarding potential circuit failure modes and detectability.

✓ Provide on-going systems and software design expertise to engineering team finalizing RoHS 2 / EU CE-mark compliance activities.  Evaluate and advise team on potential software and systems impacts of selected component substitutions.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Concurrent with the continued role as Software Group Lead, stepped up to take on the overall leadership of the entire department of electrical and software staff.

✓	Manage team resources to accomplish multiple quick-turn “60 day wonder” customized products/engineering samples while keeping long-term new product development cycles on track.

✓	Accountable for the professional growth and performance of approximately 8-10 Electrical & Software Engineering team members.

✓	Coordinate and facilitate multiple projects, eliminating roadblocks for the engineering team while communicating requirements, goals, and accomplishments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Group Lead
positions.description:
Leads the software development staff and is the key technical point of contact for providing software architectural design, cost analysis, algorithms, and code for controlling several laser & electro-optical based defense products.  Hands-on activities continue to include the design, construction, and testing of product software enhancements, delivered on-time and in accordance with all established standards.

✓	Architected a new software model for the next generation of laser products, featuring a more scalable, reusable, and maintainable real-time design.

✓	Coordinated in-house and external software resources implementing a video processing architecture targeting System-On-Module (SOM) hardware design.

✓	Revised and matured corporate software development process, continuing to mentor junior staff in it's application through a peer review system.

positions.title: Software Lead & Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Steadily progressing roles and responsibilities culminating as a Software Lead.  In this role, I led the firmware team in successfully bringing a new multi-parameter defibrillator/monitor to market.  Responsibilities include the day-to-day guidance of a 7-person team, technical coordination & triage, task planning & schedule updates, and insuring compliance with all product development processes.

✓	Facilitated and ensured that the team met key technical and schedule milestones for a major product upgrade – achieving one of the key innovation goals for the FY11 corporate incentive plan.

✓	Broke new ground as the first major product introduction to be developed under 62304 compliant software processes – pioneering new templates and approaches adopted by follow-on projects.

✓	Developed and taught a seminar on “Emerging Techniques in Safety Critical Software Design” based upon 3 months of independent research conducted during a structured learning sabbatical.

✓	Wrote a graphics emulation that reduced (~6 months) the integration lag time between hardware introduction and providing functional software.

In previous software roles within this organization I was a key member of the technical staff and ultimately led the small team developing the embedded software for an Automatic External Defibrillator (AED):

✓	Introduced and championed use of hierarchical state machine (HSM) models on multiple products.  This approach significantly improved translation of user needs into accurate/complete designs.

✓	Key technical contributor for prototyping next-gen wireless monitoring using “agile” techniques – melding these more flexible management techniques with a traditional product development model.

✓	Initiated the development of new low-cost AED software designs focused on integrating SoC and ASIC mixed-signal technologies.

positions.title: Systems Engineer / Software Team Lead
positions.description:
Performed key systems engineering definition and coordinated the overall software design activities for the modernization of the AFIS air/ground data communication system for business & general aviation aircraft.

✓	Selected key technologies and developed migration strategies to move existing 7x24 operations on to high-availability (99.98%) architecture utilizing a load-balanced multi-platform design written in Java and using both IBM MQSeries message queuing threads and Oracle data management services. 

✓	Received personal recognition award for the rapid development of a TCP/IP-based communications protocol supporting the market roll out of a graphical weather up-link service.

✓	Led software development team that created the high-level design of an aviation packet data network overlay for the Iridium satellite telecom system requiring 99.999% (5 nines) service availability.

company.name: Honeywell Aerospace GDC, Redmond, WA (Formerly Allied-Signal)

positions.title: Software Project Manager / Engineering Manager
positions.description:
As a Software Project Manager:
✓	Implemented new software engineering processes and accelerated schedules that resulted in the V22 simulator program being commended by the Marine Corps for its proactive and efficient operation.
✓	Received technical achievement award for development of new avionics & peripheral real-time interfaces in both object-oriented Ada95 (GNAT) and C.
✓	Coordinated all software development, personnel, budget and scheduling.
	
As a Software Engineering Manager:
✓	Managed multi-discipline staff (35-50 engineers), key technical decisions, budgets, and schedules.
✓	Coordinated joint-development activities for 3 flight/weapons trainers, each sharing a common but extensible baseline of approx. 500 KSLOC of real-time code written in Ada, C, and FORTRAN.
✓	Designed, developed, and introduced ISO 9000 and SEI CMM-based software engineering practices.

Selected earlier accomplishments:
✓	Principal investigator for the R&D design of a next-generation platform for flight simulators.
✓	Chief Programmer & System Architect resolving all real-time design issues.
✓	Designed or approved all real-time device interfaces… receiving bonus for real-time software design.

skills.name: - Medical Devices: Defibrillators, ECG Monitoring, Wireless Telemetry
- Aerospace: Avionics Interfaces, Flight Simulation, Sensor Modeling
- Defense: Lasers & Electro-Optics, Recon. & Image Exploitation, Missle Guidance
- Regulatory: FDA cGMP, ANSI/AAMI/IEC 62304, DO-178B, ISO/IEEE 12207
- Principles: Agile Methods, SW Best Practices, SWEBOK, PMBOK, SEI CMM/CMMI
- Environments: Real-Time, Embedded, Distributed, High Availability, Clustered
- Techniques: HSMs, Statecharts, Safety Critical Design Patterns
- Lifecycle: DOORS, UML, COCOMO II Cost Estimation, MS Project, BugTracker
- Protocols: Bluetooth, SPI, I2C, USB, UDP, SCP-ECG/ISO 11073, ARINC 429, 1553
- Software Languages: C++, C (C99, MISRA), Ada 95, Java
- Processors: STMicro STM32 CM3, Microchip PIC16/PIC12, TI MSP430, Sharp LHx
- Platforms: (Bare Metal), WindRiver VxWorks, Linux (embedded), Quantum HSM
- IDEs: IAR Workbench, Eclipse, WR Tornado, MS DevStudio, Green Hills MULTI
- Tools: Subversion, Perforce, Make, Coverity, Code Collaborator, Doxygen
